corrected_control.source_consumption: exact pinned separate checkout, source-only preflight, unchanged qualified class; no modifications

design.cold_memory: Each role independently retains own selected source history across its three DEV seeds within family, zero sharing between roles/families, random no memory. MG33C exact source checkpoint serialized/restored across seeds and validated.
design.fairness: All controls obtain authentic same source public observation fields, selected actions and feedback; MG33C selectors only consume own selected action aggregate counts and public-digest inequality/reward. Original source cap equal, full wall/CPU/RSS per role UNVERIFIED.
design.source_custody: Published known prior cohorts plus parent-reachable original-source contracts checked; unknown disconnected private branches not certified.
design.policy_mechanisms: Use immutable MG19 natives, frozen MG33 frontier, frozen MG34 lookahead, frozen MG31 generic public novelty and EXACT MG33C classes; do not patch existing actors/controls after seeing results.

required_conditions: Candidate has >=1 genuine original positive terminal goal in at least two unfamiliar pickup families
Candidate has >=1 exact mission-target selected pickup effect across unfamiliar pickup families
Candidate has strictly more positive unfamiliar goal episodes than each corrected action-only control
Candidate has strictly more exact mission-target selected pickup effects than each corrected action-only control
primary_dev_filter.secondary: MG34 lookahead, native Wingless/Yggdrasil and other controls separately measured; they are not candidates in the frozen primary filter. Report target-front, distinct-target contexts, selected target pickup and door effects per role/family, full action histogram especially MG33C, and actual goal episodes. Do not infer unique world regions from public contexts or claim key possession from front locked door.
primary_dev_filter.always: development-only no heldout science, no model integration, no threshold tuning on exposed data
